assets.prompt: Landscape 3:2 Grade 7 geography lesson illustration. Reference image is a STYLE REFERENCE only: match softly hand-painted realistic school textbook artwork, textured brushwork, muted greens, warm natural light, navy school uniforms when students appear. No text, letters, captions, numbers or watermark. A clear close view of a wooden bench beneath a large leafy tree in imaginary school grounds, with branches casting visible shade over the bench and adjoining soil. A sunlit paved path runs beside it, school building softly visible in background. Show both shaded and sunny areas clearly. No people, no thermometers, no invented measurement results. Make the bench and tree dominant so students can describe a human feature and a physical feature and ask a question about temperature.
